name: Keychain Gummikins
tagline: A pocket-sized friend for keys, bags, and long commutes.

feel.texture: Tight, even stitches with a gentle bumpy ridge you can trace with a thumbnail.
feel.notes: Small enough to hold in a closed hand. Firm enough to roll between your fingers without losing its shape.

care: Spot clean with a damp cloth and mild soap. Air dry. Keep the ring away from little mouths.
description:
The smallest Gummikins you can buy, and the one that goes everywhere. Clip it to your keys, a backpack zipper, or a work badge, and you have something soft to reach for when the day gets long.

Keychain Gummikins are popular as matching sets. Get one for you and one for someone far away, so you each carry the same little face around.

name: Small Gummikins
tagline: Palm-sized and pocketable. The perfect first Gummikins.

feel.texture: Rows of rounded stitches that feel like a soft, even ridge under your fingertips.
feel.notes: Fits in one palm. Gives when you squeeze it, then slowly settles back into shape. Light enough to hold for a long time without your hand getting tired.

care: Spot clean with a damp cloth and mild soap. Reshape gently and air dry. Do not tumble dry.
description:
Small Gummikins are the ones people keep on a desk, tuck into a coat pocket, or slip into a care package. They are small enough to go anywhere and big enough to feel like *someone*.

Each one is crocheted by hand in a continuous spiral, stuffed until it is squishy but holds its shape, and finished with two shiny eyes and a stitched cream smile.

name: Medium Gummikins
tagline: A two-handed hug. Made for couches, car rides, and bedtime.

feel.texture: Plump, rounded stitches with a soft fuzzy halo. Smooth enough to rub, bumpy enough to notice.
feel.notes: Fills both hands. Has a gentle, settled weight when it sits in your lap. A slow squeeze pushes back softly.

care: Spot clean with a damp cloth and mild soap. Reshape gently and air dry. Do not tumble dry.
description:
Medium is the size most people picture when they think of a Gummikins. It is big enough to hug properly and small enough to come along for the ride.

It is the one that ends up watching TV with Grandpa, riding to appointments, and quietly taking up residence on a pillow.

name: Large Gummikins
tagline: A full armful of soft. The one that fills the empty spaces.

feel.texture: Big, generous stitches you can feel individually. Soft and slightly fuzzy, with a steady rhythm of ridges.
feel.notes: An armful. Heavy enough to feel present on your chest or lap, soft enough to lean on. Squishes deeply and slowly springs back.

care: Spot clean with a damp cloth and mild soap. Reshape gently and air dry. Do not tumble dry.
description:
Large Gummikins are made for holding. They sit in laps, fill the crook of an arm, and keep people company in hospital beds, dorm rooms, and new apartments.

If you are sending comfort to someone you can't be with right now, this is the size that says it loudest.

name: Giant Gummikins
tagline: Made to order, just for you. Big enough to lean on.

feel.texture: Large, chunky stitches with a plush, cushioned surface.
feel.notes: Pillow-sized. Holds its own shape on a bed or chair and is substantial enough to lean against. Every Giant is made after you order, so we can talk about the color and feel you want.

care: Spot clean with a damp cloth and mild soap. Reshape gently and air dry. Do not tumble dry.
description:
Giant Gummikins are special-order only. Each one takes many hours to crochet, so we make them one at a time after we have talked with you about color, timing, and who it is for.

Send us a note through the special order form and we will reply with current turnaround times and a final price.

name: Nest Blanket
tagline: A cozy crocheted nest for your Gummikins, and for you.

feel.texture: Velvety chenille with deep, cushioned stitches. Smooth in one direction, a little plush in the other.
feel.notes: Drapes over your lap or shoulders, or rolls up into a nest for a Gummikins to sit in. Has a calm, settled weight without being heavy.

care: Hand wash cold or machine wash on a delicate cycle inside a laundry bag. Lay flat to dry.
description:
Every Gummikins deserves somewhere soft to land. The Nest Blanket is crocheted in thick, velvety chenille that can be a lap blanket, a shoulder wrap, or a little nest for a Gummikins to sit in.

Pair it with a matching Gummikins for a gift that feels like a whole tiny world.

name: Texture Square
tagline: A small sensory blanket with stitches made for touching.

feel.texture: Alternating rows of smooth chenille and bumpy stitches, so your fingers can find a different feel on every row.
feel.notes: Lap-sized and easy to hold. Good for fidgeting, rubbing, folding, and unfolding. Flat and quiet, with no buttons, beads, or loose parts.

care: Machine wash cold on a gentle cycle inside a laundry bag. Lay flat to dry.
description:
The Texture Square is a small blanket designed around how it feels. Rows of velvety chenille alternate with rows of raised stitches, so there is always something different under your fingertips.

It is easy to keep in a bag, on a desk, or in the car. Some people rub the edge, some trace the rows, some just keep it in their lap.
